items.title: Gartner (IT) Flags AI Driven Cyber Risks As Top Emerging Enterprise Threat
items.summary: Gartner (NYSE:IT) reports new research that identifies AI driven cyber vulnerabilities as the top emerging enterprise risk. The firm highlights a surge in the AI security market as organizations assess how to protect AI models, data and infrastructure. The findings point to rising demand for security tooling that can monitor, test and govern AI systems across large enterprises. Gartner is far from the only stock exposed to this theme, so it is worth looking at a broader group of companies...
